data.message: All 24 others: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not contingent on unanimity. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k; stock left=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next is 500 or 100. Risk remains; this needn't maximize long-run income. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. You may choose 18 even if others choose 10.
